openingSummary.zh: 过去约两日的新主线是「Claude Code 周末 repeatable hack」与「把前沿 Agent 记忆下放到消费产品」：Karpathy 把 Tristan Hume 的 YouTube 分级单做成 TristanTube（约 4.7 万条偏硬核视频 + 电视模式），自称用 Claude Code 三分钟一键生成；@AIatMeta 把 Muse Wonder 的 Active Memory / Active Focus 训进现有模型并推到 Muse 与 Meta AI——官方称关键信息遗忘约降 2.4 倍（正确使用关键上下文 76%→90%），Personal Superintelligence Index 38%→47%，意外受阻的日常任务完成度提升约 67%。昨日已详报的 Anthropic Agent Memory / dreaming、OpenAI BioBasicsBench、FMF jailbreak 框架、DeepMind 遗留 RSA 压测、GPT‑6 Cyber 与 Cursor Voice Chat 未见实质新进展，开篇降级带过；OpenAI 另发与 Hacktron 的安全合作（经 Daybreak Red 扩大前沿模型访问）。缺口：@AndrewYNg / @claudeai / @GoogleAI / @Meta 近 48h 无高信号原创；关注列表无 DeepSeek 一手 X。
openingSummary.en: Over ~48h the new leads are a repeatable Claude Code weekend hack and shipping frontier agent-memory traits into consumer apps: Karpathy turned Tristan Hume’s YouTube tier list into TristanTube (~47K nerdy videos + TV mode), saying he one-shotted it with Claude Code in three minutes; @AIatMeta brought Muse Wonder’s Active Memory and Active Focus into specialized models for Muse and Meta AI—officially a ~2.4× drop in forgetting goal-critical info (critical-context use 76%→90%), Personal Superintelligence Index 38%→47%, and a 67% lift on everyday tasks that hit unexpected blockers. Yesterday’s headlines—Anthropic agent memory/dreaming, OpenAI BioBasicsBench, the FMF jailbreak framework, DeepMind’s legacy-RSA stress test, GPT‑6 Cyber, and Cursor Voice Chat—had no material follow-up and are noted only briefly. OpenAI also posted a Hacktron partnership expanding Daybreak Red access. Gaps: @AndrewYNg / @claudeai / @GoogleAI / @Meta quiet on high-signal originals; no DeepSeek primary X on the watchlist.

summary.zh: Karpathy 把 Tristan Hume 的 2026 YouTube 频道分级单做成 TristanTube：约 4.7 万条偏硬核视频并带电视模式，自称用 Claude Code 三分钟一键生成（呼应本周初的 HackerTube）。
summary.en: Karpathy turned Tristan Hume’s 2026 YouTube channel tier list into TristanTube: ~47K nerdy videos plus TV mode, one-shotted with Claude Code in three minutes (a follow-on to this week’s HackerTube).

summary.zh: Meta 把用 Muse Wonder 训练的专用模型推到 Muse 与 Meta AI：Active Memory 减少遗忘仍相关的目标信息，Active Focus 在约束变化时找替代路径；官方称关键信息遗忘约降 2.4 倍，受阻日常任务完成度提升约 67%。
summary.en: Meta shipped specialized models trained with Muse Wonder to Muse and Meta AI: Active Memory keeps still-relevant goal context, Active Focus finds alternatives when constraints change; official figures are a ~2.4× drop in forgetting critical info and a 67% lift on blocked everyday tasks.

caption.zh: Muse / Meta AI 专用模型配图（来源：@AIatMeta）

title.zh: 把专用模型带给 Muse 与 Meta AI（Active Memory / Active Focus）
title.en: Bringing Specialized Models to Muse and Meta AI (Active Memory / Active Focus)

summary.zh: 11/6：并非新发 Muse Wonder，而是用其对现有产品模型做专用化。官方评测：Personal Superintelligence Index 38%→47%；正确使用关键上下文 76%→90%（与 X 所称「遗忘约降 2.4 倍」一致，即 24%→10%）；Active Focus 使遇意外阻碍的日常任务完成度提升约 67%。数字为 Meta 自报，未见独立复测。
summary.en: Nov 6: not a new Muse Wonder launch—existing product models specialized with it. Official evals: Personal Superintelligence Index 38%→47%; tasks correctly using critical context 76%→90% (matches the X claim of a ~2.4× drop in forgetting, i.e. 24%→10%); Active Focus improves completion of everyday tasks with unexpected issues by ~67%. Author-reported; no independent replication cited.

title.zh: 与 Hacktron 合作，在 OpenAI 系统中查找漏洞
title.en: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems

summary.zh: 11/6 Security：与 Hacktron 联合选定高优先级测试范围，重点看系统与第三方服务的交互；同时经 Daybreak Red 扩大 Hacktron 对前沿模型的访问。属 GPT‑6 Cyber / 防御窗口叙事的后续合作，而非新模型发版。
summary.en: Nov 6 Security: OpenAI and Hacktron will jointly pick high-priority test areas, focusing on how systems interact with third-party services, and expand Hacktron’s frontier-model access via Daybreak Red. A follow-on to the GPT‑6 Cyber / defender-window arc—not a new model launch.

title.zh: 人机协作 Agent 加速遗留 RSA 密码分析（补充到两篇技术 PDF）
title.en: Human-guided agents accelerate legacy RSA cryptanalysis (two technical PDFs now located)

summary.zh: 11/6 X 长文《Advancing the frontier of cryptanalysis》：人机协作 Agent 在遗留 1024-bit RSA 上发现两类弱点——签名填充在攻击者控制约一半及以上签名块时不再提供保护（沙盒复现已解基准密钥，CPU 时间约降 3.5 倍）；短指纹场景理论算法约快 1600 倍；批量分解每个额外 1024-bit 密钥均成本约降 30 倍。现代 2048-bit+ 仍安全。deepmind.google 独立博文路径仍未解析到；今日补到两篇 Google Storage 技术 PDF。
summary.en: Nov 6 X article *Advancing the frontier of cryptanalysis*: human-guided agents found two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA—padding adds no protection once an attacker controls roughly half or more of the signed block (sandbox reproduction on an already-solved benchmark key used ~3.5× less CPU); a new algorithm is theoretically ~1,600× faster in the short-fingerprint case; batch factorization cuts average cost per extra 1024-bit key by ~30×. Modern 2048-bit+ remains safe. No stable deepmind.google blog path; two Google Storage technical PDFs were located today.

alphaxivTop3.title: FrontierPhysics: Evaluating Agents for End-to-End Physics Research
alphaxivTop3.authors: Bingran You, Wenjun Ke, Bo Liu, Wenbo Chen, Xuandong Zhao et al. (BenchFlow / UC Berkeley / Caltech / Harvard et al.)

summary.zh: （Agent/科学评测优先；采集时页面约 #2 Trending）42 位物理学家基于自身研究出 56 题、覆盖 9 个方向；22 模型共 26 种配置，没有任何配置在 168 次 rollout 中通过超过 46 次。页面图示 Claude Opus 5.5（Claude Code）Pass@1 约 27.4%，GPT‑6 Astra 约 23.2%。作者对 GPT‑6 Astra xhigh 失败轨迹的人工标注显示，主因是推理不够严谨与缺乏专家直觉，而非物理知识或执行错误。
summary.en: (Agent/science-eval pick; ~#2 Trending at collection) 56 tasks from 42 physicists’ own research across nine domains; none of 26 configs over 22 models passed more than 46 of 168 rollouts. Page chart: Claude Opus 5.5 (Claude Code) Pass@1 ~27.4%, GPT‑6 Astra ~23.2%. Manual review of GPT‑6 Astra xhigh failures tags weak rigor and missing expert intuition ahead of physics-knowledge or execution errors.

alphaxivTop3.title: Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
alphaxivTop3.authors: Hongyin Luo, Wei Fang, Daniel Suit, Dana Wensberg, Jack O'Brien (Subconscious / MIT / Princeton / Northeastern)

summary.zh: （长程 Agent 优先；采集时约 #6 Trending）把推测解码从加速器改成「关键推理的精度分配」：训练 draft 在决策点被拒绝，让目标模型在噪声最低的窗口起点重写关键 token；只训练托管参数的约 0.06%（DeepSeek‑V4.1‑Flash）到 0.28%（GLM‑5.3）。GLM 在 DeepSWE 上 60.6%→67.6%（+7.0pp，差分 95% CI 2.6–11.4）；DeepSeek‑V4.1‑Flash 为 67.8%→71.8%（+4.0pp，CI −1.3–7.3，统计上未确立）。
summary.en: (Long-horizon agent pick; ~#6 Trending) Recasts speculative decoding as a precision allocator: train the draft to be rejected at decision points so the target rewrites critical tokens at the lowest-noise slot; only ~0.06% (DeepSeek‑V4.1‑Flash) to 0.28% (GLM‑5.3) of hosted parameters are trained. GLM DeepSWE 60.6%→67.6% (+7.0pp, 95% CI 2.6–11.4); DeepSeek‑V4.1‑Flash 67.8%→71.8% (+4.0pp, CI −1.3–7.3, not statistically established).

alphaxivTop3.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
alphaxivTop3.authors: Cheng Yang, Kaituo Feng, Wenqi Shao, Jiaqi Wang, Xiangyu Yue et al. (Qwen / MMLab / CUHK / Tsinghua / HKUST GZ / Explore Academy / Jingdong)

summary.zh: （Computer-Use Agent 优先；采集时约 #9 Trending）双循环：外环用开放世界语料与模型弱点指导下一轮数据，内环从教学视频挖工作流并合成可验证任务；失败时快照回滚、保留有效前缀。作者自报 CUA-Master-27B：OSWorld Verified 80.2、OSWorld 2.0 36.9、WeaveBench 43.9、Agents’ Last Exam 25.0。
summary.en: (CUA pick; ~#9 Trending) Nested loops: an outer world–data–model flywheel steers the next data round from open-world corpora and model weaknesses; an inner loop mines tutorial-video workflows into verifiable tasks, with snapshot-rollback retries that keep a valid prefix. Author-reported CUA-Master-27B scores: OSWorld Verified 80.2, OSWorld 2.0 36.9, WeaveBench 43.9, Agents’ Last Exam 25.0.

summary.zh: 相对上周的 GPT‑6.1 Terra / 用量档位 / Gemini 4 Carbon 与 Genie 4，本周主线换成「安全专用智能体 + Agent 记忆产品化 + 科学/日常评测 + Claude Code 能周末交付」。OpenAI 以 GPT‑6 Cyber、FMF jailbreak 框架和 Hacktron 合作把网络防御做成可对外的能力与评测语言；Anthropic 用 agent memory / dreaming 讲跨会话学习，Meta 则把 Active Memory / Active Focus 推进 Muse 与 Meta AI。科学侧从 Vault 颗粒、可验证推理 FlashProve、LifeVal，走到 BioBasicsBench 与 FrontierPhysics。产品/工程上，Karpathy 用 Claude Code 连做 HackerTube 与 TristanTube，Cursor 上线 Voice Chat 与 Live Apps。缺口：关注列表仍无 DeepSeek 一手 X，Gemini 应用侧本周几乎静音。
summary.en: Versus last week’s GPT‑6.1 Terra / usage tiers / Gemini 4 Carbon and Genie 4, this week’s arc was cyber-specialized agents, productized agent memory, science/everyday evals, and Claude Code as a weekend shipping stack. OpenAI turned defense into an external capability and scoring language via GPT‑6 Cyber, the FMF jailbreak framework, and a Hacktron partnership; Anthropic detailed cross-session learning with agent memory/dreaming, while Meta shipped Active Memory/Active Focus into Muse and Meta AI. On the science side the week ran from vault particles, FlashProve, and LifeVal to BioBasicsBench and FrontierPhysics. Product/engineering-wise, Karpathy used Claude Code for both HackerTube and TristanTube, and Cursor shipped Voice Chat and Live Apps. Gap: still no DeepSeek primary X on the watchlist, and Gemini’s consumer surface was largely quiet this week.

label.zh: 安全智能体成为可对外的能力与评测语言
label.en: Cyber agents became an external capability and scoring language

text.zh: 11/6 GPT‑6 Cyber（ExploitGym 相对上代约 +51%，经 Daybreak Red 放量，11/12 还有 Cyber livestream）之后，同周还有 Linux 本地提权流水线叙事、FMF 网络向 jailbreak 评级框架、与 Hacktron 联合测第三方交互，以及 DeepMind 用 Agent 压测遗留 1024-bit RSA（现代 2048+ 仍安全）。Tibo 则把终态说成「人人可用的超安全基础设施」，但到达前会有动荡。
text.en: After GPT‑6 Cyber on Nov 6 (about +51% vs the prior generation on ExploitGym, Daybreak Red access, with a Nov 12 Cyber livestream), the same week brought the Linux local-privilege-escalation pipeline narrative, the FMF cyber jailbreak rating framework, a Hacktron partnership on third-party integrations, and DeepMind agents stress-testing legacy 1024-bit RSA (modern 2048+ still safe). Tibo framed the end-state as hypersecure infrastructure for everyone—after some turbulence.

label.zh: Agent 记忆从研究帖走进产品模型
label.en: Agent memory moved from research posts into product models

text.zh: Anthropic 工程博客把跨会话记忆拆成组件，并用离线「dreaming」整理日志、纠错与建 wiki（强调告诉模型记忆用途而非写法）。周末 @AIatMeta 把 Muse Wonder 的 Active Memory / Active Focus 下放到 Muse 与 Meta AI：区分仍相关与已过时的上下文，并在计划受阻时换路。记忆不再只是 chatbot 的聊天记录，而成了长程 Agent 的产品卖点。
text.en: Anthropic’s Engineering post unpacked cross-session memory and offline “dreaming” (log consolidation, corrections, wikis)—tell the model what memory is for, not how to write it. Over the weekend @AIatMeta brought Muse Wonder’s Active Memory and Active Focus into Muse and Meta AI: separate still-relevant from stale context, and reroute when a plan stalls. Memory is no longer just chat history; it is a product claim for long-horizon agents.

label.zh: 科学与日常任务开始有可复用的 Agent 尺子
label.en: Science and everyday work got reusable agent yardsticks

text.zh: OpenAI 先发 LifeVal（由用户反馈塑造的日常助理基准），再与 Ligo 推出 BioBasicsBench（100 项湿实验日常分析；GPT‑6 Astra xhigh 均分约 66.7% vs GPT‑5.6 Sol 43.8%）。Anthropic 用 Claude 协助解析细菌/噬菌体来源 Vault 颗粒，并讨论 AI 写/拟合科学模型。论文侧 FrontierPhysics 用物理学家自己的课题做端到端评测，显示即便 Claude Opus 5.5 也远未「可发表」。
text.en: OpenAI shipped LifeVal (an everyday-assistant bench shaped by user feedback) and, with Ligo, BioBasicsBench (100 wet-lab routine tasks; GPT‑6 Astra xhigh mean reward ~66.7% vs 43.8% for GPT‑5.6 Sol). Anthropic used Claude on the first 3D structure of a bacterial/phage vault particle and on writing/fitting scientific models. On the paper side, FrontierPhysics turns physicists’ own projects into end-to-end tasks and shows even Claude Opus 5.5 is far from “publishable.”

label.zh: Claude Code 与计算机使用把「周末能上线」变成常态
label.en: Claude Code and computer-use made weekend shipping feel normal

text.zh: Karpathy 周一用 Claude Opus 5.5 / Claude Code 约两小时做出 HackerTube，周日又用 Claude Code 三分钟一键做出 TristanTube。中间还有 OpenAI 的物理世界工程（CAD/PCB/仿真）、Images 2.6，以及 Cursor 的 Build Live Apps 与 Voice Chat。alphaXiv 热榜也从 harness 搜索（HarnessFlow / Meta²）滑向 CUA-Master 这类计算机使用论文——模型和套件都在比谁更能把长程任务做完。
text.en: Karpathy spent ~two hours with Claude Opus 5.5 / Claude Code on HackerTube early in the week, then one-shotted TristanTube with Claude Code in three minutes on Sunday. In between, OpenAI showed physical-world engineering (CAD/PCB/simulation) and Images 2.6, and Cursor shipped Build Live Apps plus Voice Chat. alphaXiv’s hotter agent papers also slid from harness search (HarnessFlow / Meta²) toward computer-use work such as CUA-Master—models and harnesses alike are being judged on finishing long jobs.

text.zh: 关注列表仍无 DeepSeek 官方一手 X（仅能从论文如 Adversarial Speculative Reasoning 里看到 DeepSeek‑V4.1‑Flash 被当作目标模型）。@AndrewYNg 本周仅 11/5 预热 AI Dev NYC，之后静默；@claudeai 在 Personal Finance（11/5）后近 48h 无新帖；@GoogleAI / Gemini 应用侧相对上周 Carbon、Genie 4、Drops 几乎无新高信号；@karpathy 也是周末才再出现。数条本周数字（ExploitGym +51%、遗忘 2.4 倍、多项论文分数）均为官方或作者自报。
text.en: The watchlist still has no DeepSeek official primary X (DeepSeek‑V4.1‑Flash appears only as a target model in papers such as Adversarial Speculative Reasoning). @AndrewYNg was quiet after the Nov 5 AI Dev NYC preview; @claudeai posted nothing high-signal in the latest 48h after Personal Finance (Nov 5); @GoogleAI / the Gemini app surface had little new versus last week’s Carbon, Genie 4, and Drops; and @karpathy reappeared only over the weekend. Several weekly figures (ExploitGym +51%, the 2.4× forgetting drop, multiple paper scores) are official or author-reported.

summary.en: No new product ship on Nov 8. Latest primaries: Nov 6 Engineering *The components of agent memory* (dreaming—cross-session log consolidation, corrections, wikis; covered yesterday); same-day Claude Help Center notes Enterprise project tags to track spend by cost code (beta). summary.zh: 官方 changelog 今日可访问，Latest 仍为 v0.78.1（2026-10-27）——购物卡片、「立即购买」、Vault Shop Pay、订阅模板、自定义模式下的云端智能体、团队 Bot Vault。Homebrew cask 与 OpenNavo 显示 Mac 客户端已到 0.79.3（cask generated_date 2026-11-07），此前 0.79.2（约 2026-11-05），均高于页面 Latest；官方未公布 0.79.x 说明。changelog 常滞后客户端，故对照写出两端版本，而不宣称近期无客户端更新。
summary.en: Official changelog reachable today; Latest still v0.78.1 (2026-10-27)—shopping cards, Buy now, Shop Pay in Vault, subscription templates, cloud agents in custom modes, Team Bot Vault. Homebrew cask and OpenNavo show the Mac client at 0.79.3 (cask generated_date 2026-11-07), after 0.79.2 (~2026-11-05), both above page Latest; no official 0.79.x notes published. Changelog often lags—report both ends rather than claiming no recent client builds.
